facts.fact: The ministry's communique says the national government cloud is meant to host State services while respecting digital sovereignty, among applications already engaged under the Digital-Y project.

systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Transformation and Modernisation of Administration

facts.fact: The ministry says a reference framework for State digital architecture standards, drawn from March 2026 consultations with 118 representatives of 34 ministerial departments and inspired by TOGAF and GovStack, has been elaborated, with a Digital Architecture Council planned to enforce it; no adoption is stated.
